items.text: – Vwoooo, Baba Baba, uzongithengeya lo nodoli omkhulu?
items.q: On the street, a stranger's little girl asks her dad for a big doll. Does it sound like baby talk?
before: – Amir, Amir-jan, ndodana yami. Vuka. Vukela uMaman. Bekuyiphupho nje. Ungesabi, ngilapha.

…obumnyama kodwa esingakhanyisi okwanele ukungihola noma kuphi. Isibani esicwayizayo esandleni sentombazane engazange ngazi umbala womnyango wendlu yayo, engangingakwazi ukuwubeka ebhokisini lamapensela ombala. Intombazanyana iyeza igijima, ikhalisa, ime eduze kwami. Ibuka amathoyizi. Ithi:

items.text: Nawe, ngaleyo ndlela yakho yepipi yokukhuluma, igama lakho bekufanele ngabe ngu-Alain Bolon.
items.q: 'Alain Bolon' is meant as a rude pun on the actor Alain Delon. Would Zulu readers get it? If not, what word could carry it?
before: – Yebo, Hamoon yigama elihle kuwe. NjengoHamoon osefilimini, nawe ugcwele imibuzo. Ugcwele ukukhathazeka futhi ungumthombo wokuphazamiseka, hhayi kuwe, kodwa kimina.

items.q: Her son says he would die for her; Maman objects. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Isandla sami sifushane futhi ukuhlangana nawe kukude.
items.q: Amir tells the girl he loves why he holds back. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Ngithi uma uhlala lapha nje ufunde izinkondlo, akukho sinkwa esiyokufudumalela.
items.q: A friend criticises Amir for reading poetry all day. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: UBibi, uNkulunkulu amxolele, wayevame ukuthi ngezikhathi ezinjengalezi: uma ngikusho, ulimi lwami luyasha; uma ngingakusho, umnkantsha wamathambo ami uyasha.
items.q: Maman hesitates before criticising her husband. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?
The family's New Year visits were cancelled; a brother jokes about it. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: – Kodwa izandla zakho mazingabi buhlungu. Kulezo zinyanga ezintathu owamthatha ngazo waya naye eDenmark, ngajabula kangakanani!
items.q: Is it clear this is a warm thank-you for taking Baba to Denmark?
before: – Yebo, uqinisile, Nini-jan. Kodwa njengoba uMahboub esho, noma yini esiyishoyo imane ihlikihle imizwa yethu kakhulu.

items.text: Kwelami icala ngiqaqa umucu wamazwi; kwelakho uyawubutha.
items.q: Is it clear that 'uyawubutha' means you gather up the words?
before: …yale ncwadi isidlulile. Imizuzwana nezithombe ezazingalahleka emsindweni wezinguquko zomhlaba ukube azibhalwanga lapha. Zabhalwa ukuze zibe yibhuloho phakathi komhlaba wami nowakho: lisuka emhlabeni wami ngesikhathi ngibhala le misho, liye emhlabeni wakho ngesikhathi uhlala phansi uyifunda.
